    Fanography 3-Folds¶

    This section records the 105 smooth Fano threefold families from Fanography. Entries with supported flag-variety inputs include computed ambient matrices; entries marked Catalog only have reference descriptions without a computed matrix.

    Realization types. Entries labelled direct flag variety or complete intersection can be entered in gwflags. Homogeneous-bundle entries require the corresponding bundle constructor. Catalog-only entries link to reference information; no executable input or computed matrix is provided here.

    The displayed matrices are A(1) A ( 1 ) , first-Chern quantum multiplication on the returned ambient space, with columns as images of the ordered basis. The returned grading is G=diag(codimei−dim⁡X/2) G = diag ( codim e i − dim ⁡ X / 2 ) . Spectral tables state their own parameter point. See notation and scope.

    Fano Variety 1-1¶

    1-1

    Description: Double cover / weighted degree-6 hypersurface (Fanography). Realization type: Catalog only — not represented by the current gwflags flag-variety/ordinary complete-intersection input model.

    Fano Variety 1-2¶

    1-2
    • Ambient Space: $A4$
    • Keep Nodes: 1
    • Bundle K: 4
    • Ambient Index: 1
    • Dimension: 3
    • Basis Rank: 4
    • Description: Hypersurface of degree 4 in P4 P 4 ; double cover of 1-16 with branch locus a divisor of degree 8.
    • Realization type: Line-bundle complete intersection.
    Spectrum and connection exponents

    Parameter point: y1=1.

    Here A(y) A ( y ) is first-Chern quantum multiplication on the returned ambient space, and G G is its centered codimension grading. Columns are images of the ordered basis. Notation and scope.

    χA(a)(z)=∏ipi(z)mi χ A ( a ) ( z ) = ∏ i p i ( z ) m i , with the monic factors below. Each multiplicity and exponent multiset applies separately at every root λ λ of the indicated factor.

    Factor pi(z) p i ( z ) Distinct roots Multiplicity mi m i per root
    z−232 z − 232 1 1
    z+24 z + 24 1 3

    Unit cyclic determinant: ΔA(a)=1 Δ A ( a ) = 1 , in this basis.

    Regularized exponent multisets Fa,λ F a , λ , with classes in Q/Z Q / Z :

    Repeated entries retain their multiplicity.
